It pins: MuleResolver — cross-file flow-ref; MuleResolver — config-ref + dynamic; MuleResolver — Mule 3 legacy endpoint + exception-strategy refs; MuleResolver — MUnit migration evidence.
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of mule-resolver
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
